name: Semiotic Magiks

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Hermetic Seal of the Great Work

VINIT.justification: The unformed potential before the imposition of symbolic intent.

TANCH.justification: The final state of completion where the system is sealed.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of intent toward the realization of the sigil.

AREV.justification: The dissolution of form back into the primordial state.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of symbolic operations into a coherent spell.

IMSCRIB.justification: The sigil acknowledging its own existence as a causal agent.

FSPLIT.justification: The bifurcation of intent into active and passive currents.

FFUSE.justification: The synthesis of polarized currents back into a unified manifestation.

EVALT.justification: The successful anchoring of the sigil in the material plane.

EVALF.justification: The failure of the sigil to hold form, resulting in energy loss.

ENGAGR.justification: The state where the sigil is both active and dormant, held in suspension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, immutable inscription of the completed work.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the unwritten page.
phase_3.true_description: The sigil is fully realized and active.
phase_3.false_description: The sigil has dissolved into noise.
phase_3.both_description: The sigil exists in a state of potentiality and actuality simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Genesis of the raw intent from the void.
Bifurcation of intent into active and passive currents.
Acceleration of the active current toward the target.
Affirmation of the active current as a valid path.
Descent of the passive current to ground the energy.
Negative evaluation of the passive current to ensure balance.
Reconstitution of the currents into a unified manifestation.
Chaining the manifestation to the practitioner.
The sigil recognizes its own causal signature.
Permanent recording of the sigil in the Akashic Record.
Sealing the system to prevent further leakage.

phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The rhythm of the lunar cycle

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The symbolic energy is conserved through the transformation of intent into form.
